sections.title: Example Campus guide
sections.text: Example Campus provides the following student services.

sections.title: Academic leave
sections.text: Students may take up to three consecutive terms of academic leave. A request starts with the student portal, then needs an advisor's approval.

sections.title: Credit transfer
sections.text: A transfer request must include the course outline and an official transcript. Only courses graded B or higher are eligible.

sections.title: Internship
sections.text: Students need at least 84 credit units to register for an internship. A workplace mentor must sign the weekly log.

sections.title: Example Campus deadlines
sections.text: The following deadlines apply to internship administration.

sections.title: Registration and reporting
sections.text: Internship registration closes on April 15. The final report is due 14 days after the placement ends.
